title: ‘Congratulations!’: World leaders hail Lula’s election victory in Brazil
summary: The international community on Monday congratulated Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva after his stunning re-election in a runoff with right-wing candidate Flavio Bolsonaro.
